summary: Comprehensive testing of AX10 presentation at /ax10 route. All features working correctly: 16-slide presentation loads with cover slide visible, all navigation methods work (arrow buttons, keyboard arrows, dot navigation), slide counter shows correct numbers (1/16 through 16/16), PDF download button generates 'AX10_Presentation.pdf', fullscreen button present, progress bar at top, AX10 logo visible on slides. Mobile responsiveness verified at 390px width with all UI elements accessible. Touch swipe navigation implemented in code (verified via code review). All text in Russian as expected.

minor_warnings.issue: Console shows 'Buffer is not defined' errors during PDF generation
minor_warnings.note: Known issue with @react-pdf/renderer v4.x in browser environments. PDF still generates and downloads correctly. Non-blocking.
